items.title: Heritage Reserve Fund Request - Heritage Intern Contract Position
notes: Report from M. Iglesias, Manager of Planning Services

M. Iglesias, Manager of Planning Services, provided an overview of the report, indicating due to recent changes to the Ontario Heritage Act, through Bill 23, municipalities will be losing the ability to protect properties from demolition or inappropriate alteration which is currently afforded to “listed” properties on the Municipal Registry. She indicated moving forward, municipalities will have two years after adding a property to the Registry to designate or remove the property from the list. The Township currently has 1,052 properties on the Municipal Registry, 121 designated and over 900 listed.

Staff is requesting the hiring of a Heritage Intern to assist within increasing the number of designations this year. The intern will cost approximately $15,000 for a four month term and costs associated with administration (newspaper notices and legal fees) will be approximately $18,000-$20,000.
M. Iglesias responded to questions pertaining to the source of funding, and the preservation of the information currently on the list.

items.title: Termite Management Services Update
notes: Report from A. McNabb, Managing Director of Corporate Services & Treasurer

A. McNabb, Managing Director of Corporate Services & Treasurer provided an overview of the report, indicating staff is recommending engaging in discussions with a known supplier licensed to utilize the Sentricon product in Canada. He noted the purpose of supplier engagement would be to determine vendor’s willingness to participate in a termite management program with the Township, potential scope of service provision, preferred pricing options, or other opportunities to effectively address termites in Centre Wellington.
